source: Monster Beverage Corporation 2026 Q3 press release and SEC Form 10-Q
case_equivalent_definition: 192-ounce case equivalents, entire company energy drink case sales
notes: Consolidated sales include international operations and non-energy-drink activities.
A case equivalent is not necessarily the same as a retail can purchase.
Average net sales per case is a manufacturer metric, not consumer retail shelf price.
No claim is made that any hypothesized price, flavor or marketing shock caused the reported growth.
